description: A conceptual map illustrating a rural agricultural landscape with various land cover and land use types. The legend on the right defines the following features: "Hay meadows" are depicted in dark green; "Arable land" is shown in light yellow; "Farms" are represented by black rectangular polygons; "Trees" are indicated by small green tree icons; and "Roads" are light green, elongated polygons. The map displays large contiguous areas of hay meadows, interspersed with smaller, rectangular parcels of arable land. Multiple farm building complexes are visible as black polygons, some situated within or adjacent to the hay meadows. Scattered trees, individually and in small clusters, are present, particularly along the boundaries between different land parcels and near farm structures. Roads traverse the landscape, connecting different areas. The overall pattern shows a mosaic of managed grasslands (hay meadows) and cultivated fields (arable land), with associated infrastructure and natural elements.
